note: Binance refusing work it never started, worded as in the Spot API error codes: -1001 and -1008, both of which ask the caller to try again, sent with a 4xx status. On a server error the same codes are outcome_unknown, because Binance documents every 5xx as an unknown execution status.

json.msg: Internal error; unable to process your request. Please try again.
Server is currently overloaded with other requests. Please try again in a few minutes.
